definition: The location and orientation of a coordinate frame in three dimensional space, corresponding to the STEP axis2_placement_3d:  a location (the origin of the frame), an axis (the direction of its local z axis) and a ref_direction (the direction of its local x axis).  The local y axis is implied, being the cross product of the other two.  Orientation is expressed as direction cosines rather than as angles, so no rotation sequence convention is implied.  N.B.:  STEP represents the location as a cartesian_point and each direction as a direction, all of which are separate entities; here they are held as coordinates on the placement itself, since PGEF has no need of independently identified points and directions.
name: Axis2Placement3D
